Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join assays on chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614459', then activities on assay_id, then molecule_dictionary on molregno, then compound_structures on molregno. Filter activities where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
